title: Bainbridge Island Discovery and Bloedel Reserve Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the best of Bainbridge Island on this unforgettable Bainbridge Island tour featuring scenic viewpoints, hidden island gems, local history, and the world-famous Bloedel Reserve. This small-group experience combines nature, culture, art, and Pacific Northwest beauty into one relaxing and immersive day trip from Seattle.

Unlike typical Seattle day tours, this experience takes travelers beyond the main tourist areas to explore some of the most unique things to do on Bainbridge Island, including the Bainbridge Island Japanese American Exclusion Memorial, Halls Hill Lookout and Labyrinth, waterfront viewpoints, and Pia the Peacekeeper Troll by world-renowned artist Thomas Dambo.

Perfect for visitors looking for a Bainbridge Island sightseeing tour, a peaceful nature escape near Seattle, or a curated Pacific Northwest experience, this tour offers personalized service, comfortable transportation, and a calm concierge-style atmosphere that feels authentic, local, and unforgettable.
